reviewPurpose: Phase 5.1 product ownership and release-readiness audit. This is an internal evidence register, not a promise that any item is for sale.
decisionRules: A public demo or source repository does not establish that a downloadable, installable or supported commercial product exists.
Repository license metadata applies to the code covered by that license; it does not establish ownership of every dependency, brand, hosted service, data set or third-party asset.
No product may be marked ready-to-install until packaging, prerequisites, installation instructions, clean-install verification, licensing, support and update policy are evidenced.
Do not invent prices, commercial terms, warranties, SLAs, support channels, release dates, client relationships or agency contribution.
STRIDETO is a live platform candidate but is not presumed to be an agency resale package.
Auto-Trading-Agent remains gated by its separate roadmap and is not a Phase 5 launch candidate.

products.name: STRIDETO
products.currentState: Owner-associated live platform; repository README describes production-ready platform and documents deployment paths. External uptime, current terms and operational ownership were not independently checked in this audit.
products.accessModel: Free-to-use per owner-maintained agency catalogue; public platform access, not a downloadable package.
products.licenseEvidence: README states MIT license and links LICENSE. Confirm exact license scope, notices, third-party assets and current legal terms before any redistribution or commercial packaging.
products.installationEvidence: Developer setup and environment/deployment documentation are described in README; no customer self-service installation or clean customer-environment install was verified.
products.pricing: No agency resale price approved. Public service access described as free; do not infer paid enterprise terms.
products.supportAndUpdates: No customer support commitment, SLA, update channel or maintenance policy approved for agency marketplace.
blockers: Confirm product ownership and operator authority for any commercial offer.
Separate public hosted service from source-code redistribution rights and service terms.
No approved customer packaging, onboarding, support or update policy.
Do not imply agency delivery or ownership.
evidenceLimitations: README statements are repository-authored claims, not independent production verification.
Public availability and regional access must be checked separately before publishing a live badge.

products.name: RegexLab
products.currentState: Public browser tool; repository README describes regex testing, animated replay and learning workflows.
products.accessModel: Public browser application; no paid download or hosted customer workspace evidenced.
products.licenseEvidence: README displays MIT license badge. Exact LICENSE contents, dependency notices, mascot/brand and bundled asset rights require explicit review before redistribution.
products.installationEvidence: Repository README includes local development and deployment information; customer installation package, versioned release artifact and clean-install test are not evidenced in this audit.
products.pricing: No price approved. Do not add a price or imply a paid edition.
products.supportAndUpdates: No paid support, SLA, update cadence or customer maintenance policy approved.
blockers: Verify LICENSE file and third-party notices/asset rights.
Decide whether product is only a free hosted tool or whether a separate distributable package is intended.
If distributable, create versioned package, customer installation guide and clean-install evidence.
Define support/update policy only if a commercial offer is approved.
evidenceLimitations: README feature claims have not been independently re-tested in this audit.
Public URL uptime and browser compatibility were not checked.

products.name: JotJSON
products.currentState: Public browser tool; README identifies version 2.0.0 and describes local-first JSON tooling and learning experiences.
products.accessModel: Public browser application; README claims zero-backend/zero-telemetry client-side processing. No paid download or hosted customer workspace evidenced.
products.licenseEvidence: README states MIT. Verify exact LICENSE, dependency notices, editor/component licenses and all visual/mascot assets before redistribution.
products.installationEvidence: README describes application features; customer install package, versioned downloadable release and clean-install test are not evidenced in this audit.
products.pricing: No price approved. Do not add a price or imply a paid edition.
products.supportAndUpdates: No paid support, SLA, update cadence or customer maintenance policy approved.
blockers: Verify LICENSE file and all third-party notices and asset rights.
Keep privacy statements aligned with actual network behavior and current build.
Decide whether free hosted tool only or distributable product is intended.
If distributable, create versioned package, installation guide and clean-install evidence.
evidenceLimitations: Privacy and local-only processing statements are README claims, not independently tested in this audit.
Public URL uptime and compatibility were not checked.

products.name: SiteIntel Pulse
products.currentState: In development. GitHub Pages URL is a static design/documentation showcase; full scanner requires a separate Node.js host. README headline calls it a public live platform, which conflicts with the internal release boundary and must be reconciled before any public availability claim.
products.accessModel: Static showcase only; no verified hosted interactive scanner endpoint in this audit.
products.licenseEvidence: Not verified in this audit. Inspect repository LICENSE, dependency notices, rule definitions, report templates and assets before redistribution.
products.installationEvidence: Repository contains Node.js application and deployment references; no customer-ready installer, hosted multi-tenant production service or clean external installation was verified.
products.supportAndUpdates: No customer support or update policy approved.
blockers: Resolve conflicting README 'public live' wording versus static-showcase/in-development boundary.
Verify production hosting, security, tenancy, rate limits, backups, privacy and operational readiness.
Verify exact license and third-party notices.
Create documented deployment/customer installation process and clean install evidence.
Define report/data retention and support/update policy before release.
evidenceLimitations: README test counts and feature claims are not re-run or independently validated by this Phase 5.1 audit.
Static showcase is not proof of full scanner availability.

products.name: Free AI Mixer
products.currentState: In development. README describes an orchestration UI/system requiring a separately configured scene-generation API; no hosted public demo or production provider endpoint is evidenced.
products.licenseEvidence: Not verified in this audit. Inspect LICENSE, provider SDK terms, model/provider terms and bundled assets before redistribution.
products.installationEvidence: README lists npm install/dev/build commands and environment variables; a production API deployment, customer setup guide, secure credential provisioning and clean external install are not evidenced.
products.pricing: No price approved; provider usage costs and any customer billing model remain undefined.
products.supportAndUpdates: No customer support, provider uptime commitment, update cadence or maintenance policy approved.
blockers: Implement and verify a real supported API endpoint and provider configuration flow.
Define secure customer credential handling; never expose provider secrets in browser code.
Test provider failure, retries, rate limits, usage/cost controls and job lifecycle end-to-end.
Verify license/provider terms and produce deployment/install docs.
Define customer data retention, support and update policy.
evidenceLimitations: README describes intended orchestration behavior, not a verified hosted service.
No successful external generation flow was verified in this audit.

products.name: Auto-Trading-Agent
products.currentState: Separate Solana-only roadmap is active; README states live trading is not authorized and market-data/source decisions remain unresolved.
products.accessModel: Not available to buy, install or operate for customers.
products.licenseEvidence: Not verified; do not infer redistribution rights.
products.installationEvidence: Not a Phase 5 install candidate. Separate project roadmap and owner approval govern future readiness.
products.pricing: No Agency marketplace price approved. Separate repository contains a proposed commercial model, which is not authorization to advertise or sell.
products.supportAndUpdates: No customer support or update commitment approved.
blockers: Remain excluded until separate roadmap exit criteria and explicit owner release approval.
No live trading, returns, investment advice, hosted trading or commercial availability claims.
Do not change the frozen trading-agent roadmap through this agency marketplace phase.
evidenceLimitations: README is a snapshot from the recorded source commit; current operational state must be checked in that repository.

overallFinding: No candidate currently meets the agency marketplace's ready-to-install gate based on evidence reviewed. STRIDETO is a reference hosted platform, RegexLab and JotJSON are public browser tools, SiteIntel Pulse and Free AI Mixer remain development-stage, and Auto-Trading-Agent remains excluded.
nextAuditActions: Owner confirms which products are actually owned/controlled and which may be offered by the agency.
Inspect exact LICENSE files and third-party notices for each candidate.
Verify current public URLs and application behavior separately from README assertions.
For any proposed distributable product, define package format, prerequisites, clean-install procedure and release artifact.
Approve pricing, support and update terms only after product scope and operating costs are known.
